title: Late by one day: is the land acquisition appeal barred?

scenes.dialogue: Advocates, if a land acquisition appeal comes even one day after the one hundred and twenty day limit, can a High Court condone the delay?
scenes.shown: Advocates, if a land acquisition appeal comes even one day after the 120-day limit, can a High Court condone the delay?

scenes.dialogue: A two judge bench of the Supreme Court, in S V Global Mill, applied the Limitation Act to these appeals. Now another bench disagrees. So is the limit rigid?
scenes.shown: A two-judge bench of the Supreme Court, in S.V. Global Mill, applied the Limitation Act to these appeals. Now another bench disagrees. So is the limit rigid?

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. On sixteenth October, Honourable Justice Dipankar Datta and Honourable Justice Sheel Nagu ruled.
scenes.shown: Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. On 16 October, Honourable Justice Dipankar Datta and Honourable Justice Sheel Nagu ruled.

scenes.dialogue: Under the twenty thirteen Act, the land acquisition authority at Jaipur allowed a company's reference, and later its review, with a minor change.
scenes.shown: Under the 2013 Act, the land acquisition authority at Jaipur allowed a company's reference, and later its review, with a minor change.

scenes.dialogue: The Rajasthan Housing Board and the State did not appeal under Section Seventy Four. Instead, they filed a writ petition under Article Two Twenty Seven.
scenes.shown: The Rajasthan Housing Board and the State did not appeal under Section 74. Instead, they filed a writ petition under Article 227.

scenes.dialogue: The High Court dismissed it: an appeal was the remedy. Section Seventy Four gives sixty days, and sixty more under the proviso. Even that had run out.
scenes.shown: The High Court dismissed it: an appeal was the remedy. Section 74 gives 60 days, and 60 more under the proviso. Even that had run out.

scenes.dialogue: In the Supreme Court, the Board relied on S V Global Mill, seeking liberty to file a late appeal. When the Bench doubted it, the Board asked for a larger bench.
scenes.shown: In the Supreme Court, the Board relied on S.V. Global Mill, seeking liberty to file a late appeal. When the Bench doubted it, the Board asked for a larger bench.

scenes.dialogue: Before I tell you what the Supreme Court decided, a quick request: follow LawWorld, and try India's all in one A I platform for advocates at lawworld dot A I.
scenes.shown: Before I tell you what the Supreme Court decided, a quick request: follow LawWorld, and try India's all-in-one AI platform for advocates at lawworld.ai.

scenes.dialogue: Finally, what did the Supreme Court decide? It held the hundred and twenty days inflexible and rigid. An appeal even a single day beyond is barred.
scenes.shown: Finally, what did the Supreme Court decide? It held the 120 days inflexible and rigid. An appeal even a single day beyond is barred.

scenes.dialogue: The Court disagreed with S V Global Mill, but declined a reference. In any case, the Board never filed an appeal, so its special leave petition failed.
scenes.shown: The Court disagreed with S.V. Global Mill, but declined a reference. In any case, the Board never filed an appeal, so its special leave petition failed.
